offending_extra_words: Vendor further warrants that all Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner
reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present: professional and workmanlike standard (19.1), express software conformance for 12 months and Services conformance for 90 days from performance (19.2A), repair/replace/refund remedies (19.4), Applicable Law compliance and no malicious code (19.3).

Minimality fails: 19.2A restates the professional-and-workmanlike warranty already granted verbatim in 19.1, duplicating protection where only the software 12-month and Services 90-day conformance periods needed inserting.

Drafting gap to note (not a deviation): 19.4's remedy trigger still cites only "breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2," so the new 19.2A software and Services conformance warranties are not expressly linked to the repair/replace/refund remedy; adding "19.2A" to the cross-reference would close it.
Deleting "after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation" and "materially" from 19.2 benefits Customer and leaves the untouched commercial terms of 19.1, 19.3 and 19.4 effective.
